notes: Each model gets one response, is told it may think as long as it likes, and has an output cap with a median of 65,536 tokens. Most runs finish their answers. All models get the same prompt, one response and no tools. Output caps appear to follow each model's own limit or a shared batch setting. Cut-off answers hit models from Alibaba, Anthropic and OpenAI alike, and each affected model has a better setting listed. We found no setting that gives one model or developer a material advantage.

notes: Each leaderboard row is one pass over the 100 puzzles; two runs used two passes. Standard errors are about 4-5 percentage points, so rows less than about 10 points apart cannot be ranked reliably. At least five runs are recommended.

Epoch says the benchmark asks for the single best move as judged by Stockfish. In 99 of 100 puzzles the reference move beats every alternative by at least 1.5 pawns, so the score tracks that skill.
